notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it, causing target player to discard a card.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.
